prompt: Write a Python function that takes a list of integers and returns a new list containing only the even numbers, sorted in descending order. Include type hints and a docstring.

Implement a regex pattern that validates a Python function signature. It should match function definitions with optional decorators, parameters (with type hints), and a return type annotation. Provide the pattern as a string variable.

Write a JavaScript class called TodoList with methods: add(task), remove(index), toggleCompleted(index), and getActive(). Use ES6 class syntax and include a constructor that initializes an empty array.

Create a Bash script that monitors disk usage and alerts when any mounted filesystem exceeds 90% capacity. Use a while loop to run the check every 60 seconds and log warnings to /var/log/disk_alert.log.
Write a Rust function `fn fibonacci(n: u64) -> u64` that computes the nth Fibonacci number iteratively. Include a comment explaining the time complexity and handle edge cases (n=0, n=1).
